# Hostelworld

> > Global hostel and budget accommodation booking platform connecting backpackers and travelers with hostels, B&Bs, and guesthouses worldwide.

Hostelworld is the leading online booking platform for budget travelers, offering hostel reservations, bed and breakfast bookings, and guesthouses across major destinations in Asia, Europe, and beyond. The platform features the Hoscars awards, traveler reviews, and social travel features including traveler chat to connect the global backpacker community.

## Key Topics

- Hostelworld booking platform
- Budget accommodation and hostels
- Backpacker travel
- Bed and breakfasts (B&Bs)
- Asia travel destinations
- European hostels
- Hostel listings and reviews
- Hoscars awards
- Social travel and traveler chat
- Budget lodging worldwide
- Guesthouse bookings
- Climate Neutral certification
- Major cities: London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Rome
- Popular destinations: China, India, Taiwan, Panama

## Platform Overview

- [Hostels Worldwide - Online Bookings, Ratings and Reviews](https://www.hostelworld.com): Main homepage for Hostelworld backpacker hostel bookings worldwide
- [Des auberges de jeunesse dans le monde entier - Réservations, évaluations et avis en ligne](https://www.french.hostelworld.com/): French homepage for Hostelworld hostel booking in London, Berlin, Amsterdam
- [Bed and Breakfasts | Book Cheap B&Bs & Guesthouses Online](https://www.hostelworld.com/bed-and-breakfasts): B&B booking hub for bed and breakfasts worldwide via Hostelworld
